Requirement statement: BESS stays connected and exchanging current through the Table B (ESR) voltage-time envelope at the POIB, cumulative over 10 s
Active power returns to its pre-disturbance level within 1.0 s of POIB voltage recovery
Inject current on the affected phases in symmetrical and asymmetrical faults, reactive priority; blocking only in the permissive region
EMT pass line: BESS reactive: Iq > 0.02 pu (capacitive) while V is depressed and above 0.10 pu

Requirement statement: No trip from PLL loss of synchronism, phase-angle jump or ROCOF
EMT pass line: BESS PLL: post-event PLL within 0.5 Hz of 60 Hz

Requirement statement: Ride through the IBR frequency table (58.8–61.2 Hz continuous)
Load rides through the NOG 2.15 Table A envelope at the POIB; returns to ≥90% within 2 s; a transfer scheme begins return ≤0.25 s and reaches ≥90% ≤0.5 s
No trip or transfer scheme based solely on a number of sags within a period
Load current ≤150% of normal maximum, for no more than 0.5 s
Load rides through the LCL frequency table (58.8–61.2 Hz continuous)
Voltage at buses above 100 kV recovers to 0.90 pu within 5 s (P1) or 10 s (P2–P7) of clearing
0.2–2 Hz oscillations decay with at least 3% damping
Angular and voltage stability; frequency excursions; generator ride-through boundaries; no UFLS (first stage 59.3 Hz)
